_about: laneHORSE v2 (staged, DARK, UNPROVEN in Unity). Read by Assets/Scripts/Mount/MountRider.cs (summon, speed, dismount, gait) and, for the size, by the static camp horse (hub.json npc_horse runtime.horseScale). enabled=false ships dark. Units metres, seconds, degrees. Copy to Assets/Data AND StreamingAssets.
_notes: heightM = height at the WITHERS (Dom: warhorse 1.75 m; Joan 1.58, Pitborn 2.5, Sobek 3.12, Grendel 3.24, Erlking 4.06 from roster.json / GameConfig). glbHeightM = the height the glb was exported at (1.75), so scale = heightM / glbHeightM: change heightM and BOTH the ridden horse and the static camp horse resize. Head top at 1.75 m withers = 2.14 m, body length 2.82 m nose to tail, width 0.87 m. seatRaiseM (0.72 at glbHeightM): Joan's pelvis bone at the saddle (back 1.52 m up at the seat; Mixamo hips about 0.87 m on her 1.58 m); seatBackM 0.13 = the saddle is 0.13 m behind the glb origin (barrel centre). Mounted: Joan head top about 2.3 m, camera back/height multipliers lift the lock camera (CameraRig hook). requireOwned = item id in loot_save.json owned[] (bought from the stable vendor, market.json row); empty = free. speed: multipliers on walkSpeed/runSpeed (Joan 2.2/5.5 m/s -> 3.5/12.1). stamina is the horse's own: empty = no gallop until minToGallop. dismount.onStrike: an attack key dismounts (v1, no fighting from the saddle). noMountZ: boss arena world-z ranges; play_areas.json rows (zones 4+) also count when playAreaIsBoss; the camp and every safe zone dismount via dismount.inHub. gait: the glb has no rig, so bob / pitch / roll are a function of the ground speed (cycles per metre), gallop when the run key is held. camera.* is read by a 2-line CameraRig hook.
